name: Gongs & Chimes of the World
subtitle: Gong Ageng, Bonang & more
shortDescription: 8 gongs, chimes and bells to play: Gong ageng, Bonang, Kyi waing and Bianzhong.
longDescription:
Gongs & Chimes of the World: 8 gongs, chimes and bells from around the world, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Gong ageng, Bonang, Kyi waing, Bianzhong, Pyeongyeong, Yunluo, Skrabalai and Handbells.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can strike hanging gongs, gong circles, chime bells and stone chimes to real rhythms and melodies, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
